steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX capability required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Confirm the delivery location was selected.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publishing.
Commit a schedule starting now with a four-hour duration.
Verify the footer schedule chip displays the requested four-hour duration.
Add the vendor named by the test case.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Verify the published Project Details page exposes the bidding end-time field.
Confirm no application error appeared during scheduling or publishing.
